description: Turn one place name into coordinates with the public Nominatim service. OpenStreetMap data is ODbL. A fresh lookup is cached, and the hub store allows one fresh Nominatim call a second for every worker together. Does not spend points and does not accept a URL. If you supply fields, the hub returns privacy_consent_required until the controller has accepted the current privacy version. Do not invent that acceptance.
name: hub_geocode
